tasks_completed.description: Investigated root cause: mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay did not clear day.accommodation when editorSelections[accKey] === null
tasks_completed.rationale: When editorSelections has the accKey with value null (explicit deselect), selectedAccId resolves to null, the if(selectedAccId) branch is skipped, but day.accommodation is never cleared — it stays as the published accommodation from the deep-clone. The outer render check {day.accommodation && ...} stays truthy, so the card renders.

tasks_completed.description: Added else-if clause in mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay to set day.accommodation = null when key is explicitly null
tasks_completed.changes: Added 3 lines after the existing if(selectedAccId) block: else if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(editorSelections, accKey) && editorSelections[accKey] === null) { day.accommodation = null; }
tasks_completed.rationale: The fix targets the root cause: when a drag-to-sidebar sets editorSelections[accKey] = null, mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay must propagate that null into the merged day object so the render condition {day.accommodation && ...} evaluates to false and the section disappears.
Standard post-fix regeneration and deploy cycle

tasks_completed.rationale: cardCount=0 after drag, cardStillExists=false — fix confirmed working

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — logic gap, not a regression from a specific commit
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay handled the selectedAccId truthy case (update accommodation) and the key-absent case (use persisted value) but had no branch for key-present-value-null (explicit deselect). The if(selectedAccId) guard silently skipped the null case without clearing day.accommodation.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Added an explicit else-if branch that detects key-present-value-null and sets day.accommodation = null, which causes the {day.accommodation && (...)} render guard in KanbanDayView to hide the entire accommodation section.
